monte_carlo.sharpe_basis: per-trade (annualised at the observed trade frequency) — NOT comparable to the per-bar Sharpe elsewhere in this report
monte_carlo.resampling: trade sequence resampled WITH REPLACEMENT (bootstrap); the realised trade ORDER is not preserved or permuted
monte_carlo.interpretation: Distribution of outcomes over bootstrap resamples of the realised trade sequence (sampled WITH REPLACEMENT), each resample replayed as an equity curve. p5 below 0 means a fifth of resamples lose money.

capacity.note: Assumes costs scale linearly; real capacity is lower once market impact is modelled.
